questions.stem: An agent prunes old tool results by rule, and the team also needs a customer's stated wish to survive a summary and a new session. Which pair fits?

options.text: Context editing for the clearing, and a longer system prompt for the wish
options.says: Ruled out because "Your context window might be reset at any moment", so a prompt cannot hold state.

options.text: Context editing for the clearing, and memory files for that fact
options.says: The page pairs them: "consider using both: compaction keeps the active context small without client-side bookkeeping, and memory preserves the information that must survive summarization."

options.text: Citations for the clearing, and the Files API for the wish
options.says: Ruled out because the Files API stores files and does not clear anything: "upload and manage files".

options.text: Threshold compaction for the clearing, and prompt caching for the wish
options.says: Ruled out because prompt caching changes what you pay: "prompt caching changes what you pay for those tokens, not whether they count."

questions.stem: A request to compact a conversation on demand returns a `compaction` block. What must the next request do with it?

options.text: Drop its signature, so that the summary can be edited by the application
options.says: Ruled out because a block with a changed signature is rejected: "The signature and content must be exactly as returned."

options.text: Append it after the summarized messages, which stay in the list as before
options.says: Ruled out because "the summarized messages are removed, or the request returns a 400 error (`compaction_block_misplaced`)", and here they stay in front of the block.

options.text: Send it first in the messages, in place of the ones it summarizes, exactly as it came
options.says: The page says "It goes first in `messages`, in place of the messages it summarizes", and "Send it in future requests exactly as it came."

options.text: Send it in the system prompt, where summaries are expected to sit
options.says: Ruled out because the block belongs in `messages`, not elsewhere: "the block comes first".

questions.stem: A pipeline needs a cited answer and a result in a fixed JSON shape from the same documents. What design does the module support?

options.text: One call with the schema inside each document's `title` field
options.says: Ruled out because "`title` and `context` fields of a document are passed to the model but are not citable", and a schema there is not applied.

options.text: One call with both features, since each one works on its own
options.says: Ruled out because "Citations and structured outputs are incompatible."

options.text: One call with citations on half of the documents and off for the rest
options.says: Ruled out because "citations must be enabled on all or none of the documents within a request."

options.text: Two steps: one call that cites, and a second that only formats
options.says: The page says "cite in one call, and shape the result in a second call that has no documents".

questions.stem: A program drops messages from a long history and the next request fails with a 400 error. Which cause fits the module?

options.text: The newest turn was kept even though it was over the budget
options.says: Ruled out because "The newest turn always stays, even if it alone is over the budget."

options.text: A tool result stayed while its call was removed
options.says: The page says "Tool result blocks must immediately follow their corresponding tool use blocks in the message history", and that a list which keeps one without the other "fails with a 400 error".

options.text: The first turn was pinned so that the task stayed in view
options.says: Ruled out because a pinned turn is a whole turn: "Optionally pin the first turn".

options.text: An older summary was folded into the new one as required
options.says: Ruled out because a second compaction "should fold the first summary into the new one".

origin.section: Never split a call from its result
